description: This file defines the 'UpdateCommandController' class which handles HTTP requests to update command entities. It includes methods to process JSON request bodies, perform repository updates, and log audit actions.

classes.name: UpdateCommandController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling command update HTTP requests, performing update operations via the repository, and logging audit actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: CommandRepository and ActivityPublisherService.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request for updating a command; extracts command ID, processes input, updates in database, and logs the action.

methods.name: auditAction
methods.description: Logs an audit entry indicating the command was updated by a specific user.
